title: Phoenix Event Envelope v1
description: Common envelope for every event on the Phoenix event bus. Consumers must tolerate unknown additional fields.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier; used for deduplication.

event_type.description: Namespaced, lower-case, dot-separated type, e.g. kage.meeting.started.

version.description: Envelope schema version (major.minor). This schema covers major version 1.

source.description: Identifier of the emitting capability or core component.

correlation_id.description: Groups events belonging to the same task or workflow.

causation_id.description: event_id of the event that caused this one.

subject.description: What the event is about, e.g. a repository or site.

requires_action.description: True when the user must act.

ttl_ms.description: Milliseconds after timestamp when the event expires.

payload.description: Event-specific structured data. Must never contain secrets.

provenance.description: Where the information came from (source system, ids, URLs).
